faqs.q: How much does Netsmart myEvolv cost?
faqs.a: Netsmart myEvolv pricing is enterprise-custom, typically ~$300/user/month. Annual contracts range from $50K-500K+ depending on organization size and modules. Implementation costs are additional (9-24 month timeline). Long-term contracts (3-5 years) are common with volume discounts.

faqs.q: Is myEvolv good for community mental health centers?
faqs.a: Yes, myEvolv is specifically designed for CMHCs and large behavioral health organizations. Key features include automated state reporting, grant management, multi-program support (MH, SUD, DD), care coordination, and compliance documentation. It's used by many Medicaid-funded agencies.

faqs.q: How long does myEvolv implementation take?
faqs.a: myEvolv implementation typically takes 9-24 months for large organizations. This includes data migration, workflow customization, staff training, and state reporting configuration. Smaller implementations may complete in 6-9 months. This is significantly longer than private practice EHRs (1-3 months).

faqs.q: What are alternatives to Netsmart myEvolv?
faqs.a: For enterprise behavioral health: Qualifacts CareLogic (~$50/provider/mo base) or Netsmart myAvatar. For addiction treatment: Kipu EMR ($600-10K/mo). For smaller organizations: Valant ($100-300/mo) or TherapyNotes ($49/mo). For health systems: Oracle Health or Epic.

Yes, Netsmart offers telehealth through Netsmart Telehealth, which integrates with myEvolv. This includes video visits, scheduling, and documentation. Telehealth is typically an add-on module to the base EHR contract.
